messages:
Lina: new mock for axis tick formatting and unit density in mini dashboards. problem: tiny tiles show awkward commas and long unit names. idea: compact tick formatter + legend unit hover that reveals full formatting rules. Marco: nice. concrete: default tick format = SI short (k, M) for >1000, but allow workspace override to binary for bytes. legend shows unit short form (MB) and hover shows full rule: \"SI short, 2 sig figs\". Priyanka: accessibility note: tooltips must be keyboard accessible and announced. suggestion: make the hover a focusable button with aria-expanded and provide text fallback: \"Ticks use SI short: 1.2k\". Evan: outlier UX: when there's a big spike, axis autoscale compresses the rest. propose a tiny capped icon on the top-right of chart area; clicking it overlays raw spike as dashed line and adds a legend note \"spike at 12.4k\". overlay should be a separate canvas layer to avoid redraw. Lina: microcopy proposals for tooltip: - \"Ticks: SI short (2 digits)\" - \"Formatting: SI short, two significant figures\" I prefer the first for brevity. Marco: perf/impl: compute tick formatting server-side as part of metadata so UI just reads format string. stable DOM keys: series_id + metric_name. avoid re-rendering main canvas on hover. Priyanka: keyboard/ARIA sketch: ```html
Ticks: SI short (2 digits)
``` Ensure Enter toggles and Escape closes. announce clipping/spike notice when overlay toggled. a11y-bot: reminder: 44px min touch target for the MB button, visible focus ring, and tooltip text must be accessible to screen readers. CI will run axe on the preview. Lina: action items: Marco 1 add server metadata plan; Priyanka 1 add aria examples + SR test; Evan 1 sketch overlay canvas and clip badge behavior. I'll push an updated prototype later today with the capped icon and tick info popover. :white_check_mark:
